behavior: Given more than 200 matching records whose unbounded serialization exceeds 256 KiB inside an allowed interval, a successful authenticated MCP query returns at most 200 records and at most 256 KiB, reports truncation, and exposes no pagination cursor or continuation token.
rationale: An over-budget dataset traversing the real storage and wire boundaries discriminates server-enforced limits from client-side or mocked truncation.
